capabilities: Plot notes on a timeline from start/end date properties
Group timeline items by any note field
Draw background ranges and vertical-line markers from matching notes
Style items via CSS classes and data attributes
Render timelines programmatically through api.render and Dataview integration
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the full API reference lives in separate documentation. A warning covers CSS snippet changes needed when upgrading from versions below 1.9.
problem: Obsidian's Bases core feature has no timeline visualization for notes that carry start and end date properties.

relations.evidence: Thanks to vis-timeline and obsidian timeline
Thanks to vis-timeline and obsidian timeline
Previewing these blocks requires the Dataview plugin.

summary: A Bases view that plots notes with date properties on a timeline, with grouping, backgrounds, markers, and an API for custom rendering.
